notes.en: This separate illustrative call/context composition does not guarantee a native embedded sidebar. Inspect the contracted CRM URL pop up integration (November 2023 PDF p.4), actual supported display and permission-equivalent lookup before implementation. Number association is not identity verification.

notes.en: The observation sheet contains measurement methods only: interactions, time to accurate usable context, matching, permissions and exception handling. No measured savings, percentages or fabricated baseline/results. Validate permissions as well as shared/unknown numbers and availability before valuing the proposal.
notes.ar: ورقة التقييم تعرض طرق القياس فقط: الخطوات والوقت للمعلومة الصحيحة والمطابقة والصلاحيات والاستثناءات. لا نسب أو توفير أو نتائج مصطنعة. نختبر الصلاحيات والأرقام المشتركة وغير المعروفة والإتاحة قبل تحديد القيمة.

method.boundaries: Actual source PCM: FFmpeg silencedetect -35 dB, minimum 150 ms pause, checked against Arabic Whisper-small phrase and contextual ASR.
method.labels: English semantic cue descriptions, not a verbatim transcript. Raw Arabic recognition retained. No assumed word timestamps. Short uncertain ASR fragments do not drive detailed reveals.
method.precision: Six decimal timestamp storage describes measured segmentation; it does not imply six-decimal perceptual or word alignment accuracy. Phrase triggers normally use measured starts/ends, then 350 ms visual easing.
method.external_human_listening: Not performed; no external listening or participant study claimed.
method.source_preservation: Original MP3 unchanged; no cuts, replacement, time stretching or narration padding. MP4 AAC is a lossy encoding of the entire decoded master.
method.raw_asr_segments: Raw ASR segment offsets are local to silence-padded analysis windows, not global film timestamps. They are retained for audit and do not drive animation.
